decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits close to the firm's core pipeline business, uses existing welding and coating capabilities, and was given a dedicated page, so the firm is visibly committed to it and has little reason to drop it.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core business, but it uses the firm's coating equipment, serves the same municipal customers, and was presented on its own page as part of the announced range expansion, so management is likely to persist and attribute weak sales to temporary causes such as the pandemic.

The waste bin with ashtray belongs to the same publicly presented street-furniture line, which management would rather keep than write off as a failed diversification, although it is somewhat more peripheral than the basic bin.

The outdoor ashtrays are part of the visibly launched municipal product line and need little extra investment to keep on offer, so dropping them would expose the diversification decision as a mistake.
